description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for handling hook mappings, including resolving, applying, and transforming hook configurations in a plugin or middleware system.

methods.name: resolveHookMappings
methods.description: Resolves hook mappings based on provided hooks configuration and options, returning an array of normalized hook mapping objects.

methods.name: applyHookMappings
methods.description: Applies a list of hook mappings to a given context, executing transformations and merging actions as needed.
